bio_en: Hovakim Achgheozian graduated in 1885 from the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin, belonging to the rebellious generation that produced the Gnunis, and taught for years in Trabzon, Unye and Samsun. In 1896, after his wife's death, he left his two-year-old daughter with relatives and threw himself into revolutionary life in the ARF. He travelled from place to place disguised as a peasant, a dervish or a pious Muslim until he was betrayed and arrested in Van and taken to Constantinople. He died in December 1907 in the prison of Acre.
